posts.title: Contract Extension Results
posts.body: Contract Extension Vote results will be posted here around 2000. Pass the word to other members.

posts.title: Results of the Extension Vote
posts.body:
First the negotiating committee would like to thank the Local for an impressive turn out. 

The extension was overwhelmingly rejected by a margin of 94% 

This signals that our membership is in lock step. We are united. We are ready to winter the storm. 

Continue to stay in communication with each other and your committee. We will be having the Strike Saction Vote on October 22nd from 0500 - 1900. More details to follow. 

THANK YOU!
